source.description:
Final epic milestone per xtrm-qcy contract and Q27 retirement test: same behavior from a data-defined chain through the generic runtime, ZERO SRE-specific topology code.

Scope:
1. Author the SRE workflow as a JsonChainSource (data file, not TS) using the qcy.1 schemas: steps/classes/specialist refs/deps/routes matching the current hard-coded sre-team topology in experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/src/chain/ (types.ts/topology.ts are the source of truth for shape).
2. Load via ChainLoader (qcy.2), compile via pure compiler (qcy.3), freeze.
3. Parity proof: structural equivalence between the data-defined ResolvedChain and the hard-coded topology — same entry step, same step set, same dependency edges, same specialist bindings; plus behavioral parity at the simulation seam where feasible without new runtime work (this bead does NOT build new reducer/scheduler/runtime — it proves the DATA path reproduces the TOPOLOGY; runtime parity execution is explicitly out of scope if it requires runtime changes).
4. Any SRE concept discovered still living in generic layers during migration → defect finding, fix or file.

Acceptance: zero imports of sre-team topology constants outside the experiment's own legacy files; the data-defined chain compiles to a frozen ResolvedChain whose structure matches the hard-coded one (fingerprint-level comparison documented); findings recorded.
